selected_primary.name: ACN actual charging histories plus official anonymous-user metadata
selected_primary.best_use: Real-history feature learning and reviewed observed-response benchmark; labels still required.
selected_primary.missing: Certified vehicle ID, clean latent power, exact response onset/offset and fault truth, true untreated reference.

additional_sources.name: KIT charging behavior dataset
additional_sources.local_status: ExistingLF parquet previously actually scanned, no new22GBHF download
additional_sources.best_use: Fine command-following histories and vehicle-diverse development; already previously viewed, not a fresh blind test.
additional_sources.missing: Execution ACK and general sensor-fault/clean-response labels; power columns calculated, not independent meters.

additional_sources.name: TU Dortmund dynamic charging experiments
additional_sources.local_status: Existing merged archive; metadata142records/8models, merged128CSVrecords; this round downloaded and verified field dictionary and metadata
additional_sources.best_use: Controlled changes and external PQA for subsequent response-label review; not a large independent-vehicle pool.
additional_sources.missing: Exact clean net-reduction counterfactual and general sensor-fault truth; do not equate command edge with physical response.

additional_sources.name: EPFL level3 station
additional_sources.local_status: Existing twoXLSX files actually read this round,1878sessions,minute observations,2CCS calendars
additional_sources.best_use: DC control-history supplementary studies; native minute sampling.
additional_sources.missing: Controlled flag is Pset<Preq, not actual response success; no clean response/fault labels; differentDC domain.

additional_sources.name: High-resolution PQ disturbance/EV response2026
additional_sources.local_status: Publisher paper and OSF listing/README checked; dataset archive not downloaded
additional_sources.best_use: Supplementary real charging reactions to programmed voltage disturbances.
additional_sources.missing: Not commanded DR truth; limitedvehicle configurations; author already interpolated missing frames/clipped negative current, unsuitable as unmodified sensor-artifact truth.

additional_sources.name: UTAS dynamic grid response2025
additional_sources.best_use: High-frequency real voltage-fault response transfer check.
additional_sources.missing: Programmed voltage fault window is not voluntary DR response or sensor glitch label.

additional_sources.name: Argonne ChargeX2025 response characterization
additional_sources.local_status: Official report checked; no raw download obtained
additional_sources.best_use: 10Hz commanded-pilot and measured response protocol is relevant if raw records become accessible.
additional_sources.missing: Rawdata download not located in inspected report; do not count report plots as acquired training data.

acquisition_errors: Initial sandbox GET denied, authorized public-download escalation succeeded. Some full-year official responses were truncated JSON, excluded without repair. Three canonical developmentGZIP originals fail parsing despite matching repository blobs; flagged and retained.
